design_philosophy: Modular, extensible, and AI-centric architecture for personalized GATE preparation.

phases.description: Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for core conversational AI and mock testing.

modules.name: User Interface Management
modules.description: Manages all user interactions and presentation.

modules.name: User Identity & Session Management
modules.description: Handles user registration, login, and session state.

modules.name: AI Conversation & Knowledge Retrieval
modules.description: Orchestrates AI chat, RAG, and knowledge base interactions.

modules.name: Assessment & Progress Tracking
modules.description: Manages mock tests, question generation, scoring, and performance data.

modules.name: Core Data Management
modules.description: Provides persistent storage and retrieval for all application data.

phases.description: Advanced features for personalized learning, interaction, and community.

modules.name: Personalized Learning & Planning
modules.description: Delivers adaptive learning paths and study plans.

modules.name: Advanced Interaction & Content Ingestion
modules.description: Extends interaction modalities and content management.

unified_data_contract.name: GateSter Application Data Model
unified_data_contract.description: Canonical data model for all application entities and interactions.

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email for login and notifications.

fields.name: activeSessionId
fields.description: Identifier for the user's current active session.

fields.name: messageHistory
fields.description: Ordered list of chat message pairs for a conversation.

fields.name: mockTestId
fields.description: Unique identifier for a specific mock test instance.

fields.name: testResult
fields.description: Summary of a user's performance on a mock test.
